subject: general
question: Find the area of the sector of a circle with diameter 14 cm, if the arc of the sector makes an angle of 120° at the centre of the circle. (Use pi = frac {22} {7} )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of **sector** for 120° is exactly 1/3 of the total area of the **circle**.

Total Area = (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 154 cm².

Sector Area = 154 ÷ 3 = 51(1/3) cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 51(1/3) cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Diameter** (d) = 14 cm ⇒ **Radius** (r) = 7 cm.

**Central Angle** (θ) = 120°.

**Formula Used:**

Area of Sector = (theta)/(360) × πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19b23b201bd52957c1e1ad3fdc3d5a74b7ffa35b1a6ddb265ca9b18fb4a76f6f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (120/360) × (22/7) × 7 × 7

⇒ Area = (1/3) × 22 × 7

⇒ Area = 154 ÷ 3

⇒ Area = 51.333... cm² = 51(1/3) cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 51(1/3) cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Length of an Arc

The distance along the curved line of the sector is given by l = (θ/360) × 2πr.

Area of Circle

The total internal space of a circle is calculated as A = πr².

Perimeter of Sector

The total boundary of a sector is the sum of the arc length and two radii: P = l + 2r.</p
